column1: # Provisional game profile (generated by scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py from the survey with dm/games/profile_guess.py, not checked by hand)
# the app's name when it runs this game and the ones that take their tables from it (build_apk.py)
# where its official releases are, and its icon: the ball's top colour and the ground (build_apk.py)
# versions the app does not run, for setup's message (setup_game.py identify): the main build ID of a player's files says which version they are (1.0.0: the base game
# without its update, read from a 1.0.0 dump's ExeFS and control.nacp)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# ---- NVN driver constant segments (Mario's values, the translator's built-in layout, unless the engine says otherwise) ----
# 45 shaders are built in memory (no game file, no GLSLC call): captured on the Mac with DM_NVN_SHDUMP=<version dir>/nvn_capture while playing, read by shader_split.py
# the rewritten modules are larger than the default 64 MB of used memory (Age of Calamity: 66.6 MB → 72 MB)
# the released app (Galar Native; Pokémon Sword takes these through tables_from); the shared save folder Documents/<docs_dir>/<title id>/save
# the game's own GPU choices (dm/games/game.py ENGINE_QUIRKS; Pokémon Sword takes them through tables_from): on Arm's own Mali driver, the lit R11G11B10F target drawn
# as an RGBA16F stand-in and checked for the white screen while playing (#47 #110 #111 #172)
# draws per submission part when a frame is not held whole (nvn_vk.c sub_split, DM_VK_SPLIT): Sword / Shield rarely wait on the submission they just made (32 early
# flushes in 2,400 frames, #349), so fewer, larger parts (8 submissions a frame at 1,200 draws with 150); Pokémon Sword takes it through tables_from
# a frame held whole until its present (Adreno, Arm: the replay on its own thread) is not split at all: its parts would wait for the present anyway, and from the 5th
# the hold was flushed early, so above ~750 draws the frame was never whole (fable-cpu fix 4); Scarlet / Violet keep splitting held frames (default split)
